content.reason: 현재 Specification package가 없고 이번 결정은 Project Core 필드가 아니라 active Agent Factory lifecycle skill의 내부 handoff 실행 계약을 변경한다. 요구사항과 검증 기준은 이 Intake와 Work Unit에 직접 보존한다.

content.objective: Implement and verify the lifecycle-owned two-checkpoint artifact handoff contract and ready-only execution entry contract accepted in this Intake.
content.humanReviewMethod: Human은 변경 diff, 두 checkpoint success/refusal receipt와 read-only inspection 예시, ready 실행의 무질문 진입 및 non-ready 선행 거절 test output, exact changed-path 목록을 검토하고 Work Unit 승인·rework·integration을 별도로 결정한다.
scope: Add deterministic lifecycle-owned checkpoint and read-only inspection commands with a shared JSON receipt contract.
Validate ready Intake and ready Work Unit packages through their owning managers before Git mutation.
Enforce separate Human approval, exact path and message disclosure, exact staged file isolation, path and symlink safety, race detection, failure cleanup, and replay recovery.
Reconstruct the second checkpoint commit in a fresh session and use it as worktree.py prepare base without moving branch/worktree ownership out of work-unit-execution.

Enforce ready as the single initial execution gate: reject non-ready packages before worktree preparation or scoped work, and start an explicitly requested ready Work Unit without re-asking settled decisions.
Update active lifecycle, intake, work-unit-planner, and work-unit-execution documentation.
Add focused unit and end-to-end temporary-repository tests and run the bundled plugin validator.
exclusions: Artifact JSON schema or profile redesign
Work Unit result integration or cleanup
Push, publication, marketplace mutation, reinstall, or PR promotion
expectedOutputs: skills/lifecycle/SKILL.md and skills/lifecycle/references/lifecycle.md handoff and execution-entry contract updates
skills/work-unit-planner/SKILL.md, references/work-unit-structure.md, manager tests, and execution-entry boundary update
skills/work-unit-execution/SKILL.md and references/worktree-contract.md inspected checkpoint base and pre-execution refusal update
